transcript: Yeah, so I met with a bunch of farmers today out at the Sangamon County Farm Bureau, had a great group out there. And the retaliation that China has engaged with has hurt our prices. But I will give President Trump credit. I think his implementation of tariffs in a narrowly tailored way has brought the Chinese to the table. China has been ripping us off for 25 years, particularly in the technology space. We have to hold the Chinese accountable, and so the President has used tariffs to bring them to the table. It has arguably hurt their economy, their stock market is down, but we are at a critical point now in our negotiations, and we need to get our the trade war resolved, but we also have to have an enforcement mechanism in place that causes the Chinese to not continue to engage in the cyber theft and the cyber activities that they've been engaged in. That's really what we're trying to change. Unfortunately, AG is a pawn in this trade war, and sooner rather than later, we need to resolve it.
